English for Adults · Week 1 · Lesson 3 · Day 3 · Step 2

Listening Mission

Listen for names and details. Écoutez les noms et les informations.

You can use fictional information. Do not enter your real personal details. Vous pouvez utiliser des informations fictives. N’entrez pas vos vraies coordonnées.

Using a phone or tablet? Turn the volume up. On an iPhone or iPad, check the silent switch on the side of the device. Sur téléphone ou tablette : montez le volume. Sur iPhone ou iPad, vérifiez le bouton silencieux sur le côté.

Listen for the first name.

    Listen for the last name.

      Listen to the spelling.

        Listen for the telephone number.

          Listen for the email address.

            Listen for help.

              Review the form.

              This is the fictional information from the mission. Voici les informations fictives de la mission.

              First name
              Mariam
              Last name
              Saleh
              Spelling
              S-A-L-E-H
              Telephone
              020 7946 0345
              Email
              mariam.saleh@example.com

              All of these details are fictional. Toutes ces informations sont fictives.

              You’re building confidence.
